snippet.title: Forgotten Hill The Wardrobe: Dark Mechanics - Trailer
snippet.description:
Can the evil that lies in the depths of the Wardrobe be defeated? Only one man could do it, only one man could challenge its mysteries, only the man who masters the Dark Mechanics...
The final chapter of Forgotten Hill The Wardrobe - Dark Mechanics - it's coming this fall, will you survive?
